DOWNLOAD CENTER

Project resources and official information.

RESOURCES

PROJECT LEGACY — BUILD 4.5

Download and install the build straight into your installation folder. The download can be paused, and it picks up where it stopped if you close the launcher.

VERSION 4.5 · CHAPTER 1 SEASON 4
—

The build is a large archive. The launcher needs free space for the archive and the extracted game at the same time, and removes the archive once the installation succeeds.

FIX MY GAME

Checks your game and repairs what can be repaired automatically.

IF THE GAME CRASHES AT STARTUP

Press FIX MY GAME. The launcher also repairs missing tools by itself every minute and relaunches the game automatically after a startup crash.
